title: Math Driver Robin
style: Hindi trap with English licks, heist-jailbreak energy, fast half-time bounce and clipped syncopated percussion; verse rides tense bass, kalimba plucks, and whispery callouts, pre-chorus tightens with rising chants and siren-like synth streaks, chorus hits with gang vocals and a chopped hook melody. Male vocal doubles, ad-lib panning, delay throws on key phrases, vinyl crackle, reverse swells, bright punchy mix., fake, bounce, rock
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Math Driver, corner pe plan
Delta alpha, eyes on the van
VDS Mansion, gate pe scan
Right lane lelo, no looking back
Sand box city, sab kuch fake
Toy ko tod do, make that break
Bored stare, but we don’t sleep
Thrift drift moves, low and deep

[Pre-Chorus]
336 ka signal ring
Door pe feet, no hesitating
Sirens sound, but we keep pace
One more turn, then leave this place
I can, you can, got this now
We believe, we bust somehow

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good!
Free bird, sing it back
Here them sing, we attack
Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, we don’t stop

[Verse 2]
Math Driver, architect mode
Dream ko lock kiya, now reload
Here’s my boys, thrash this toy
Take the right lane, break the noise
Police chatter, wheel pe dust
Pedals everywhere, move or bust
Extra stripe for no rage
Ringa-ringa, we cut the cage
Hood mein robin, out the mansion
Fake a break, then make the action
Bro, if we could, we do it clean
Phonk-thrift drift, mean machine

[Pre-Chorus]
336 ka signal ring
Door pe feet, no hesitating
Sirens sound, but we keep pace
One more turn, then leave this place
I can, you can, got this now
We believe, we bust somehow

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good!
Free bird, sing it back
Here them sing, we attack
Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, we don’t stop

[Bridge]
VDS Mansion, party for me
No way back, but we go free
Math Driver, do it again
G4 speed, cut through the rain
Sand box city, enough of this game
Unreal land, but we take the name
Word spun tight, fear gone cold
One last dash, then story told

[Final Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good!
Free bird, sing it back
Here them sing, we attack
Our robin, our robin
In our hood, we’re robin
